content.value:
Every robot has a built-in voltage sensor.

In the simulator, it's always present. It reports the battery voltage in volts.

In loop(), add telemetry.addData("Battery", battery.getVoltage()); then call telemetry.update() to display it.

The value is in volts.

11V or below = too low, charge battery.

12-13V = fine.

13V+ = fully charged.

The simulator shows ~14V. On a real robot, watch for sag under heavy motor load.
